exact_result: Unverified proof draft of two-sign uniformly decreasing ordinary CLD-smooth psh regularization after C=completion(algebraic closure K), around every point on one common fixed compact strict affinoid with smoothness/psh on its actual ordinary interior, for every continuous finite zero ordinary-Hessian function on every ordinary open of every good separated strict boundaryless pure analytic curve over complete nontrivially valued K, including singular/nonreduced/imperfect cases and actual generic Artinian lengths. The independently reconstructed harmonic-to-ordinary-current bridge also gives zero ordinary-current ascent under every complete analytic field extension on these curves.
concrete_gaps: The original arbitrary-dimensional P06.2 remains open outside this pure-curve scope; no higher-dimensional current-ascent or two-sign regularization theorem is proved.
Ordinary-smooth first-stage approximation over every nonclosed ground field itself is not established.

Regularization of arbitrary positive-current functions on arbitrary singular/nonreduced analytic curves is not established; the new theorem is for finite continuous zero-current functions and both signs.

The draft has only author audit, no independent mathematical verification. Standard analytic/algebraic foundations are precisely stated/cited; their classical proofs are not all rederived from first principles.
